Describe your task

Virtual assistant for online store operations

An ecommerce virtual assistant tracks catalogue updates, order exceptions and supplier follow-ups for online stores and marketplace sellers.

With ecommerce virtual assistant services, we can check product variants, track stock differences and follow up when an order misses its expected dispatch date. We bring the relevant order and product records together so your team can see what happened.

Use the same queue to track replacement requests, carrier updates and supplier questions. We record the next action and bring refund exceptions to the store owner.

Catalogue, fulfilment and marketplace support

Use an ecommerce virtual assistant across the product, order and inventory queues you already manage in Shopify or a marketplace.

Product launches and listings

A virtual assistant for online store support can prepare descriptions, images, variants, attributes and launch checklists. Verify listings against the approved SKU sheet and flag differences across channels.

Orders, service and suppliers

Coordinate order processing, tracking, returns and customer updates. Check inventory and follow up on supplier, warehouse, dropshipping or third-party fulfilment delays. Route reorder and refund approvals to the store owner.

Store reports and payout records

Ecommerce virtual assistant services can include tracking orders, returns, reviews and stock. Organise payout and fee exports for reconciliation and prepare campaign, marketplace health and promotion status updates.

Keep a delayed order moving through the right queue

Your ecommerce virtual assistant can gather the shipment history. Ecommerce virtual assistant services should keep the carrier update and unresolved customer request in one review record.

A customer asks about an order that has left the store but has no recent carrier scan. They also want to know whether a replacement is possible. This example separates the routine status update from a commercial decision the store owner may need to make.

  1. 01

    Confirm the order and shipment

    Match the help desk ticket with the order record, SKU and shipment reference. Check for partial shipments or a recent carrier update. Note what the systems agree on and which information is still unknown before replying.

  2. 02

    Give the customer a useful next update

    Use approved wording and state the current shipment status. Explain when the store will check again and log the message on the order. Keep a supplier follow-up separate from the promise made to the customer.

  3. 03

    Escalate the replacement request

    Record what the customer asked for, the relevant policy and whether an exception is needed. Assign the decision to the store owner with a review date. Update the customer after the decision using the approved channel.

Prepare the inputs and rules.

Give your ecommerce virtual assistant normal and exception orders. Ecommerce virtual assistant services need examples of missing tracking, incorrect items and return requests.

Order and ticket matching

Confirm which identifier connects store orders, marketplace orders and help desk tickets. Test an order with multiple items or a shipment split across carriers.

Current return policy

Share the approved response examples and the conditions under which a ticket can close. Agree who reviews refund, cancellation and replacement exceptions.

Inventory and supplier handoff

List the systems that hold stock information, the fields the ecommerce virtual assistant can change and the supplier contact route. Confirm whether an alert is enough or a response must be chased.

Decide what happens when the normal rule fails.

Your ecommerce virtual assistant should record why a case is waiting. A virtual assistant for online store support needs the store owner’s decision on policy exceptions.

Tracking conflicts with the customer’s report

Record the status and the customer’s account. Route any claim or refund decision with both pieces of context rather than treating a tracking scan as the final answer.

A product page and the stock record differ

Flag the SKU and both values. Ask the authorised owner to approve the correction before updating availability or pricing.

A promotion creates more requests than planned

Group urgent exceptions and establish which replies can use approved templates. Confirm the temporary coverage window before promising faster updates.

Check the work against the original brief.

Review ecommerce virtual assistant services against live order information. Your ecommerce virtual assistant should flag the cases whose promised update is due.

Accuracy across systems

Review a small set of tickets against order records and carrier updates. Check that the customer received a realistic status and time for the next update.

Age of exceptions

Separate open supplier requests, customer replies and store decisions. Give each blocked order a named owner and a date to revisit it.

Catalogue changes

Compare released changes with the approved product brief and look for incorrect variants, broken links or images attached to the wrong SKU.

Leave a record the next person can use.

Your ecommerce virtual assistant should leave pending orders with their next owner. A virtual assistant for online store support also needs each customer’s last promised update.

Plan ecommerce virtual assistant coverage for promotions

Prepare ecommerce virtual assistant services for promotion dates. Your ecommerce virtual assistant needs current offers, expected delivery windows and available reviewers.

Before the promotion

Document which offers apply, where inventory updates appear and what delivery estimates are approved for replies. Agree which channels the ecommerce virtual assistant checks and who reviews exceptions while the promotion runs.

When orders are delayed

Flag deliveries that are past the communicated date. Separate cases waiting on carrier tracking from those needing a replacement or refund decision. Keep the promised update time on each ticket so the next shift knows when to follow up.

After the rush

Compare the unresolved queue with shipment status. Record recurring issues, such as a tracking delay or an unclear returns message, so the store owner can decide whether to change the customer instructions.

Frequently Asked Questions

Ask which tasks your ecommerce virtual assistant can complete independently. Ecommerce virtual assistant services should keep refunds, store access and release approvals clearly assigned.

Can you help during promotions or launch weeks?

Share expected order volume, coverage windows and temporary response rules so the scope reflects the busiest period.

Do you have to give full store access?

Start with the permissions needed for the chosen queue, such as reading orders or preparing catalogue changes. Review additional access separately.

Can an ecommerce virtual assistant answer order-status questions?

Your ecommerce virtual assistant can check the approved order and shipment records and prepare replies using the store’s current guidance. Agree what happens when tracking is missing, a delivery estimate has changed or fulfilment needs to investigate.

Who decides refunds and replacements?

Ecommerce virtual assistant services should follow the store’s agreed policy and permission limits. Requests outside that policy go to the person authorised to decide, with the order history and customer’s question attached for review.

What information should a returns request include?

Provide the order reference, reported issue, relevant dates and any evidence your policy requires. A virtual assistant for online store support can organise those details and show what is missing before the store owner reviews the request.

How do we review completed store support?

Check a sample of resolved orders, an open case and a request that needed approval. Compare each record with the latest shipment information and any customer update promised, then clarify the instructions before the next cycle.
